a.lede: Oura has sued Ultrahuman again in a Texas federal court over its latest product, the Ring Pro.
a.title: Oura sues Ultrahuman (again) to block its latest smart ring from the US market

b.lede: Oura alleges in its newest lawsuit that Ultrahuman's Ring Pro infringes two of its patents.
b.title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its U.S. smart ring comeback
